[[Lord Jadoth]], also referred to as '''The General''', was once a [[human]] [[Margonite]] alive before the [[Exodus of the Gods]]. For unknown reasons, he was hunted down by the [[Forgotten]] and exiled to the [[Crystal Sea]]. During his exile, when the Forgotten's armada approached his refuge, he called upon [[Abaddon]] for salvation and became the first [[Margonite]] blessed with magic by Abaddon in 1 <small>[[Mouvelian calendar|BE]]</small>. He is said to be a great tactician. He currently resides within the [[City of Torc'qua]] in the [[Realm of Torment]], he began serving [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] as one of the four [[Lords of Anguish]] upon Abaddon's defeat.

== Notes ==
* To make the fight easier draw him away from his spawn point towards the City of Torc'qua. Putting your casters behind the fortress wall will allow them to cast spells in relative safety (Jadoth and his ranged allies will be unable to hit them).
** Alternatively there is a cliff on the other side of the fortress.  Hiding your casters beneath that cliff will yield similar results.
* Jadoth's group has two monks, make sure to take enough anti-healing skills.
* He is very powerful and will make short work of parties approaching him when allowing him to cast his [[Jadoth's Storm of Judgment|Storm of Judgment]] too often. [[Soothing Images]] and [[Diversion]] are effective counters.
* A [[Spirit of Truth]] will spawn near to the reward Chest after his death.
* To get the Torc'qua Chest, all Margonites must be killed. You may find that a couple hide beyond the hill towards The Stygian Veil.  Approaching this area will cause them to come toward you.
